title: 市场被AI带偏：医药遭错杀，CDMO盈利确定性成避风港？
speaker: Unidentified Jefferies Healthcare Analyst

segments.en: My question on markets now, why has this group underperformed, despite what seems to be on paper, is still a very bullish story? Indeed, that's a very fair question.
segments.zh: 现在市场的问题是，为什么这个板块表现不佳，尽管纸面上看仍然非常乐观？确实，这是个很公允的问题。

segments.en: So after June, we talked about, remember last time, for the ASCO, for a kiss, so making the history as the first Chinese company presented as a preliminary session during ASCO. But I think during that time, the markets tend to be a little bit short-term, because like everybody is chasing AI, chasing career.
segments.zh: 六月之后，我们谈到，上次在ASCO上，某家公司成为首家在ASCO全体会议上亮相的中国公司，创造了历史。但当时市场有些短视，因为大家都在追逐AI和算力。

segments.en: So even for a lot of the analysts outside the industry, they are forced to look at AI at that time. So I think market was a little bit short-term at that point, so we have a lot of fun flow like healthcare internet or maybe consumer sector becoming the funding source for AI.
segments.zh: 当时连行业外的分析师也被迫关注AI。市场有些短视，大量资金从医疗互联网或消费板块流向AI，成为AI的资金来源。

segments.en: But the thing is, back now, right? And people are still debating whether AI is a more sustainable trip or whatever the story is over. But we seek, like, amidst market volatility, so people care about earning certainty. So that's the reason why we have the CDMO sector for China.
segments.zh: 但现在，人们仍在争论AI是否更可持续。在市场波动中，人们更关注盈利确定性，这就是为什么我们看好中国的CDMO板块。

segments.en: So CDMO sector is actually with the best earning visibility in China's healthcare sector for this year. I guess to your point also, I mean, on the AI front, aside from what we see in the markets, so the driver has something of drug discovery for the sector.
segments.zh: CDMO板块今年在中国医疗行业拥有最佳的盈利可见性。关于AI，除了市场所见，AI对药物研发的驱动作用也很关键。
